paper_version.title: When Replanning Becomes the Bottleneck: Budgeted Replanning for Embodied Agents

official_code_version.snapshot_scope: Selected rule-based BRACE controller, typed state and decision contracts, replanning schedule, context strategies, telemetry schema, and controller audits; 18 files retained. Optional learned pruning modules, model-training code, checkpoints, datasets, generated outputs, credentials, benchmark answers, and files larger than 1 MB are excluded.

excluded_trainable_objects: task-specific neural router, compressor, guard, verifier, or policy
integration_screening.selected_artifact_scope: Use the rule-based BRACE controller to decide whether to replan, choose full, partial, reuse, or defer mode, allocate token and latency budgets, debounce churn with cooldown and commit windows, and emit auditable decisions. The optional learned E-RECAP module is excluded.
integration_screening.basis: The retained artifact is an inference-time harness, memory, retrieval, scheduling, security, observability, or executable evaluation mechanism. Model-training branches and trained task-specific components are outside this packet boundary.

benchmark_leakage_check.task_template_boundary: Datasets, task instances, annotations, answers, generated runs, and result directories are excluded from the selected code snapshot.
